title: Trainer Studio
subtitle: Manage your listing, plans, and bookable times

intro.title: Become a trainer
intro.body: Fill in your listing, add at least one plan and upload proof for its activity (sports-background proof for Tier C), then submit it for an admin to review. Every tier takes effect only after approval.

application.pendingBody: An admin is reviewing your trainer application and proof. Once approved, you'll be a trainer and can use your verified tiers.
application.rejectedBody: An admin did not approve this application. Update your listing and submit it again.

bg.title: {{activity}} sports-background proof required
bg.body: Tier C is reviewed too. Upload at least one verifiable sports-background proof for this activity (PDF), such as a university fitness/sports course record, enrolment at a sports school or department, a high-school or university team record, or matching sports or competition history (for running, e.g. a track team or track competition record). A coaching licence isn't required.
bg.label: Proof name
bg.labelPlaceholder: e.g. University track team record, sports department enrolment
bg.pending: Your {{activity}} sports-background proof is under review — Tier C for {{activity}} unlocks once it's approved.
bg.rejected: Your last submission was rejected. Please upload valid sports-background proof.
bg.planAfterApproval: You can add a plan for this activity once its Tier C proof is approved.
bg.proofRequired: Every activity in your plans needs proof first (sports-background proof for Tier C, a coaching certification for B/A).
bg.missingBody: Every tier, including C, is now reviewed. These plans aren't verified yet: {{activities}}. In Plans & pricing, pick the activity and upload your proof.

eligibility.required: Please enter your date of birth and confirm the information is true.
